name: uams-web/uamswp-video-directory
description: A WordPress plugin that adds a video post type and its taxonomy.

scripts.mutate: pest tests/Unit/ActivationTest.php tests/Unit/CustomPostTypeVideoTest.php tests/Unit/CustomTaxonomiesTest.php tests/Unit/CustomTemplatesTest.php tests/Unit/PluginHeaderTest.php tests/Unit/TemplateOutputTest.php tests/Unit/TemplatesTest.php --mutate --covered-only --path=includes,templates,uamswp-video-directory.php

scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level phpstan.neon.dist sets.
scripts-descriptions.mutate: Run mutation testing over the first-party PHP (the chain passes --path to narrow it). Every test file is named: the bootstrap loads Patchwork, and an unnamed run scans tests/Unit and scores every mutant killed without running it. Add a new test file here.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply the Rector sweep profile (run deliberately, review the diff).
scripts-descriptions.test:refactor: Preview the Rector gating profile; fails when it would change a file.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check the formatting with Pint without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.lint:floor: Parse every shipped PHP file with the PHP named in LINT_PHP (default: php), the supported floor.
